name: mons-rules
description: TypeScript rules engine for Super Metal Mons

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild ./src/entrypoints/mons-rules.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2022 --minify --keep-names --legal-comments=none --outfile=./dist/mons-rules.js
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && ./scripts/run-rules-tests.sh && npm run test:complete-games && npm run check:corpora && npm run build && node ./scripts/check-package.mjs .
scripts.clean: node --input-type=module --eval "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
